source.title: fix(roadmap): read a quoted tuple as an MCP key in context (#4265)

criteria: A unit test builds a plan whose Feasibility sentence says: "The fixture table in `tests/conftest.py` lists (\"reset_logfire_bridge\",)." `command_citation_problems` returns no problem. Command: `uv run devops ci test tests/roadmap/stage/test_roadmap_stage_command_citations.py`. It fails today.
The tests "an unknown key is refused" and "a known key is accepted" use a sentence that names the exposure table, and still pass.
The spec requirement says where the gate reads a quoted tuple. Command: `uv run devops openspec check`.
The golden set of the stage eval still passes. Command: `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay`.
